    StartersWall-E's stuffed pressed cob loafHollowed cob loaf filled with pesto, ham and roasted peppers, pressed and slicedHow to make it1 round cob loaf, about 20cm4 tbsp basil pesto150g leg ham, sliced150g roasted capsicum150g mozzarella, sliced1 handful of baby spinach100g salami, sliced100g semi-dried tomatoesCut the top off the loaf and pull out most of the soft inside.Spread the pesto inside the loaf.Layer in the ham, capsicum, mozzarella, spinach, salami and tomatoes, pressing each layer down.Put the lid back on, wrap tightly in cling wrap and press under a heavy pot in the fridge overnight.Cut into wedges to serve.Trash cube puffed rice barsMarshmallow puffed rice treats cut into neat cubesHow to make it60g butter250g marshmallows150g puffed riceLine a square tray with baking paper.Melt the butter and marshmallows together over low heat.Stir through the puffed rice until well coated.Press firmly into the tray and leave to set.Cut into neat cubes and stack into towers.Plant-in-a-boot pea and mint smashThe little green plant he keeps in an old bootHow to make itAs written, serves 4Bright green peas smashed with mint, feta, lemon and olive oil, piled into a bowl with a sprout of pea shoots on top, with crunchy pita chips.Cook 400g frozen peas for 3 minutes, drain and cool under cold water.Pulse with a handful of mint, 100g feta, the zest and juice of a lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt until roughly smashed.Cut 4 pita breads into triangles, brush with oil and bake at 190°C for 10 minutes until crisp.Pile the smash into a bowl, stand a few pea shoots in the middle and serve with the chips.Crispy pita with hummus and dukkahEaten with a spork. the oil.Add the pumpkin, lentils, coconut milk and water and simmer until everything is soft.Blitz the soup until smooth.Make grilled cheese from the sourdough, cheddar and butter.Serve the soup in 2 zucchini and 1 drained tin chickpeas with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp honey and salt.Roast for 35 minutes, turning once.Slice 250g haloumi and fry until golden.Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with lemon juice and salt.Top the tray with haloumi, drizzle with yoghurt and scatter with mint.SweetsGolden sponge cakesLight sponge fingers split and filled with piped creamHow to make it3 eggs100g
